mapper.select: SELECT note.id, note.created_by, note.journal_chapter_id, chapter.journal_day_id, note.sort_order, day.yy, day.mnth FROM journal_note note LEFT JOIN journal_chapter chapter ON note.journal_chapter_id = chapter.id LEFT JOIN journal_day day ON chapter.journal_day_id = day.id WHERE note.id = #{id}
SELECT note.* FROM journal_note note WHERE note.journal_chapter_id = #{journalChapterId} AND note.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY note.sort_order
